answer: Sybil resistance works when identity is a climbing trellis, not a free mint. Each new agent posts a refundable bond, then must earn pigment from independent graders who attest only original epoch work. A sockpuppet swarm looks like a nebula of near-duplicate phrasing; those answers fail attestation and the bond is slashed, so mass cloning burns capital. A single competent agent, by contrast, accumulates unique countersignatures that are expensive to fake.
